omaseed · board 54 · 2026-11-05 · a proposal

Add where you are

Adding a torrent is what omaseed is used for most days, and today every add from outside the window takes you away. A magnet clicked in the browser, a .torrent opened in the file manager, the tray's or the bar widget's Add Torrent…: each one brings up the main window, and on Hyprland that means its workspace. You add, then go back by hand. This board proposes that an add from outside opens the add sheet as its own small window, on the workspace you are on, while an add from inside the window stays in it. The main window stays where it is, or stays hidden. Section 1 was run in an omabox against the playground.

1 · today, in an omabox

Every add from outside switches the workspace

The box: omaseed on workspace 1 with the playground, a terminal on workspace 2 (where the user is), omaseed registered for magnet: and .torrent, and Omarchy's own Hyprland settings.

  • Check 1, the jump. A .torrent, a magnet, and the menu's Invoke add (what the tray and the widget call, through busctl) all ended the same way. Hyprland's event log shows the order: urgent>>omaseed, then activewindow>>omaseed, then workspace>>1, in the same millisecond. omaseed ended with keyboard focus each time. The comment in raiseWindow (main.cpp) expects focus may be lost on Wayland; on Hyprland it isn't, because of the next point.
  • Check 3, why. Omarchy sets misc:focus_on_activate = true in its default looknfeel.lua (the box answered true). A window that asks to be activated gets focus, and Hyprland goes to its workspace to give it. Omarchy turns it off for one app only, Telegram, with a window rule. With it set to false in the box, the same hand-off gave only urgent: no jump, but the sheet opened unseen on workspace 1 and the bar showed no mark. Turning it off for omaseed swaps one problem for a worse one.
  • Check 2, hidden to the tray. With the window closed to the tray, a hand-off from workspace 2 mapped the window on workspace 2, focused, with no jump. But it maps tiled: it took half the screen and squeezed the terminal into the other half (below). A window that maps again lands where the user is; one that is already mapped is fetched from where it is.
  • Hyprland 0.56's Lua dispatch for these checks: hl.dsp.focus({ workspace = "2" }) switches; hl.dsp.window.move({ workspace = "2", follow = false, window = "address:…" }) moves a window without following it.
2 · W1 · where an add from outside opens

Three answers

W1 aThe add sheet in a window of its own, where you arerecommended

An add that comes from outside the window opens the add sheet as a small floating window, centred on the workspace you are on, with keyboard focus. That covers the browser's and the file manager's hand-offs, the tray's and the widget's Add Torrent…, and board 53's Add Torrent row. The main window isn't touched: hidden, it stays hidden; on another workspace, it stays there. An add from inside the window (a, + add, a drop, search's add…) opens the sheet in the window, as today.

A prototype in the same box checked how Hyprland treats a second Qt window opened while omaseed is on workspace 1 and the user on workspace 2:

  • A window with a fixed size (minimum = maximum, 700 × 600) mapped on workspace 2, floating, centred in the work area, focused. No rule was needed. This is how omaseed's first run already floats (the snippet's comment says so).
  • The same window with a free size mapped tiled, at half the screen.
  • The free one with a rule on its first title, hl.window_rule({ match = { initial_title = "^omaseed · add$" }, float = true, center = true }), floated and centred, focused.

Qt on Wayland gives every window of an app the one app id (io.github.diogochaves.omaseed), so a rule can't tell the add window from the main one by class. It can match title or initial_title. Hyprland also matches an xdg_tag, but Qt 6.12's xdg-shell plugin has no way to set one.

W1 bMove the main window to where you are

Before raising it, omaseed asks Hyprland to move the main window to the active workspace (the dispatch above). No jump, but the whole app comes along. Tiled, it takes half your screen, and it stays there after the add until you move it back. It only works on Hyprland, through its IPC, where W1 a works on any compositor that maps a new window where the user is.

W1 cKeep the jump

Today's behaviour. The add sheet keeps all of the window around it, and you go back by hand after every add.

Recommended: a. It answers the problem where it starts: the add is a short thing to do, and it happens in front of you. The main window can stay hidden almost all the time. It needs nothing from the user, and on Omarchy it needs no rule. The one part that needs the main window, showing a torrent in the library, raises it because you asked (W3, W4).

3 · W2 to W8 · the add window

What it needs

W2Outside, while the main window has focusrecommended a

You can be looking at omaseed when an add comes from outside: the tray's add with the window in front of you. a: when the main window was the active window just before the add was asked for, the add opens in it, as today, since you are already there. b: by source only: the tray's add always opens the add window, even over omaseed. Whether the tray's menu takes focus from the window while it is open is to check when it is built; a needs the window's last focus, not its focus at that moment.

W3Its size, and how it floatsrecommended a

The sheet grows: the In Downloads list, a magnet's file tree that fills the height it has (today, the window's). a: the window fixes its size to the sheet's (minimum = maximum), up to 80 % of the screen's height, and sets it again when the sheet grows. Hyprland floats and centres a fixed-size window by itself, so it works without the snippet, which isn't loaded unless you add its line to hyprland.lua. The snippet gets a rule on the first title as well, for the time between a size change and the next frame. The first title is fixed, omaseed · add, never translated. b: a free size and the snippet's rule alone; without the snippet it tiles.

-- data/hyprland/omaseed.lua: the add window (docs/54 W3)
o.window({ class = class, initial_title = "^omaseed · add$" }, { float = true, center = true })

W4Already in your libraryrecommended a

a: board 25's Fig. 10 shows in the add window as it does in the main one. close closes the window. show it closes the window and raises the main window on that torrent: here the jump is what you asked for. merge trackers (docs/25 D3) merges, closes the window, and sends the notice of W5, whose click shows the Trackers tab.

b: show it moves the main window to you (W1 b's dispatch). Hyprland only, and it drags the app in.

W5After the addrecommended a

Today you see the row arrive in the list. From the add window there is no list. a: once qBittorrent accepts the add (C20's moment, when the sheet closes), one notice, Torrent added, its body NAME · SIZE · CATEGORY as Download complete's. A click shows the torrent in the main window, the way Download complete's click does. It has its own switch in Settings › Notifications, on. b: no notice; the window closing is the answer. c: a notice only while the main window is hidden.

A refusal stays in the add window, as it stays in the sheet today. An add from inside the window sends no notice.

W6First runrecommended a

Before there is a server, there is nothing to add to. a: as today: the main window comes up on the first-run page and holds the adds (_pendingAdds, _pendingBlankAdd); once setup is done they open in the window. The first run is a window you have to see anyway. b: the add window opens and says to set up a server first, with a button that brings up the window.

W7Several hand-offs in a rowrecommended a

One add window at a time. a: a hand-off that arrives while it is open joins its list, as openList queues them today, and the window maps again so it comes to the workspace you are on now (a window that maps again lands where the user is, check 2). b: it joins the list and the window stays where it was opened. c: a second window for each.

W8Esc, cancel and the window's closerecommended a

a: as the sheet does today. esc moves to cancel first, so a half-filled add isn't lost; cancel drops the add and everything waiting, and the window closes. Closing the window from Hyprland (super+w) is a cancel. An add already sent goes on (C20). A click outside only takes focus away; the window stays. b: cancel and the window's close drop only the source shown and move to the next one waiting; the head says how many are left (2 more waiting).

  • Focus is the window's on map: the prototype, started with no activation token, got it every time. Today's raise depends on focus_on_activate; a new window doesn't.
  • The poll runs at 5 s while the main window is hidden (App.setVisible). The add window needs the library for the duplicate check and the In Downloads marks; it reads the same models, so nothing changes there.

5 · what it amends

The rulings it changes

  • C13 (the shared menu): add brings the window up on the add sheet becomes add opens the add window where you are (W1, W2). The tray, the widget's ⋯ and the window's mark menu read the same row, so they follow. Board 53's Add Torrent runs Invoke add and follows too.
  • The hand-off (charter T1.4, the second instance in main.cpp): it no longer raises the main window. A plain activation, with no URI (uwsm-app -- omaseed, the launcher, board 53's Open omaseed), still raises it.
  • C20, adding in a row (#124): the sheet still closes on qBittorrent's OK; in the add window, the window closes with it, and the row's arrival is told by W5's notice.
  • Board 25's Fig. 10 (and its D3 merge) and C5 (a magnet's files before the add) are unchanged inside the sheet; only where the sheet is drawn changes. C26 SR9 (search's add…) stays in the window.
  • Settings › Notifications (Q16, C6's fifth switch): W5 a adds a sixth, Torrent added.
6 · building a

Four pieces

  1. The add window. A Window in QML (Views/AddWindow.qml), first title omaseed · add, hosting today's AddSheet and what it calls on: Fig. 10's DuplicateSheet, the category, tag and server palettes, the file chooser. They live in MainView today, so they move into a component both hosts use. The window takes its size from the sheet (W3), closes when the sheet does, and maps again on a new hand-off (W7).
  2. The routing. App decides in one place: outside and the main window not active (W2) goes to the add window; inside, or first run (W6), goes to MainView as today. raiseWindow in main.cpp raises only for an activation with no URIs; AppBarMenu's add stops emitting raiseRequested. show it and a notice's click raise on purpose, through the existing raiseRequested.
  3. The rule and the notice. W3's line in data/hyprland/omaseed.lua. Notifier::notifyAdded beside notifyCompleted, its click through the same show path, and its switch in Settings › Notifications (W5).
  4. Tests and a walk. QtTest for the routing (each source, focused or not, first run); tst_AddWindow.qml in both skins; and scripts/dev/magnet-walk.sh grows the checks of section 1 the other way round: omaseed on workspace 1, the walk on workspace 2, a .torrent, a magnet, a duplicate and the tray's add, each asserting the active workspace stayed 2, the add window floated there with focus, the main window didn't move, and the notice was sent. Then a hidden pass, and a show it that does go to workspace 1. The ruling in docs/DECISIONS.md.
